onemain_texas_loan_agreement_2026.txt.title: OneMain Financial Group, LLC Texas Loan Agreement and Disclosure Statement (sample form TXSTLA0726)
onemain_texas_loan_agreement_2026.txt.source_type: Lender legal page, state-specific sample loan agreement PDF. OneMain Financial Group, LLC is a state-licensed non-bank lender; the form says the lender is licensed and examined under Texas law by the Office of Consumer Credit Commissioner and that Texas and federal law govern it.
onemain_texas_loan_agreement_2026.txt.document_date: 2026-07 (form code TXSTLA0726; PDF created 2026-07-01; served with Last-Modified 2026-08-31)
onemain_texas_loan_agreement_2026.txt.extraction: scripts/extract_pdf_text.py: poppler pdftotext -layout per page; the AllAndNone barcode-font glyph runs dropped; recurring page furniture removed (SEE ADDITIONAL PAGES banner, Initials lines, the dated C.E. Agreement page footer with the form code, the Account Number/TBD page header, NNNNNNNN-TEST sample stamps); runs of spaces collapsed. No words changed. The PDF's own text layer reads 'monthlv beainnina' in the payment-schedule box and renders checkboxes as X, D, [Z], [xi and n; kept as extracted. Sample values ($5,000 over 48 months at 31.35% APR) are the lender's own.

onemain_california_loan_agreement_2026.t.title: OneMain Financial Group, LLC California Loan Agreement and Disclosure Statement (sample form CASTLA0726)
onemain_california_loan_agreement_2026.t.source_type: Lender legal page, state-specific sample loan agreement PDF. OneMain Financial Group, LLC is a state-licensed non-bank lender; the form says it is governed by federal law and the California Finance Lenders Law, Division 9 of the Financial Code.
onemain_california_loan_agreement_2026.t.document_date: 2026-07 (form code CASTLA0726; PDF created 2026-07-01; served with Last-Modified 2026-08-31)
onemain_california_loan_agreement_2026.t.extraction: Same script and rules as the Texas form. Pages 2, 3 and 5 of this PDF are scanned images with no text layer (the security, insurance, default and remedies terms and the first part of the arbitration agreement); they are marked in the text with a bracketed line and are not reproduced. Page 2 carries only the overlaid fill-in values (date, 32.86% rate). Every fee, prepayment, term, disclosure and governing-law clause is on a text-layer page.
